options.name: domain_name
options.description:
Domain name for the VAST DNS server. The domain suffix defined in the DNS server configuration is appended to
this domain name to form a FQDN which the DNS server resolves to this VIP pool. (optional filter)

options.name: enable_l3
options.description: When true, L3 networking is enabled. (optional filter)

options.name: enable_weighted_balancing
options.description: Weighted Balancing Enabled (optional filter)

options.name: enabled
options.description: True if the VIP pool is enabled (optional filter)

options.name: end_ip
options.description: Not currently in use. Use ip_ranges instead. (optional filter)

options.name: guid
options.description: Global unique ID (optional filter)

options.name: gw_ip
options.description: The IP address of a local gateway device if client traffic is routed through one. (optional filter)

options.name: gw_ipv6
options.description: GW IPv6 Address (optional filter)

options.name: id
options.description: VIP Pool ID (optional filter)

options.name: name
options.description: VIP pool name (optional filter)

options.name: peer_asn
options.description: The client network's ASN. Applicable only if enable_l3 is true. (optional filter)

options.name: port_membership
options.description:
Allocation of left, right or all CNode ports to the VIP pool. Allocating the left port and the right port in
different VIP pools enables the CNodes to be connected to multiple networks simultaneously. Default: all
(optional filter)

options.name: ranges_summary
options.description: IP ranges (optional filter)

options.name: role
options.description:
'PROTOCOLS' dedicates the VIP pool to client traffic from all of the supported access protocols (NFSv3, NFSv4.1,
NFSv4.2, SMBv2, S3, Database, Block, Kafka). At least one VIP pool must be created to enable client access.
'REPLICATION' dedicates the VIP pool for connectivity with an async replication peer cluster. This is needed for
async replication. 'BIG_CATALOG' dedicates the VIP pool to VAST Catalog query access from the client network.
(optional filter)

options.name: start_ip
options.description: Not currently in use. Use ip_ranges instead. (optional filter)

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the VIP pool (optional filter)

options.name: subnet_cidr
options.description:
The subnet expressed as a CIDR index (number of bits in each IPv4 address that belong to the subnet) (optional
filter)

options.name: subnet_cidr_ipv6
options.description: IPv6 Subnet CIDR prefix (bits number) (optional filter)

options.name: sync
options.description: Synchronization state with leader (optional filter)

options.name: sync_time
options.description: Synchronization time with leader (optional filter)

options.name: tenant_id
options.description:
Tenant ID. If set, only the tenant with this ID can access the VIP pool. If not set, the VIP pool is accessible
to all tenants. (optional filter)

options.name: tenant_name
options.description: Tenant Name (optional filter)

options.name: title
options.description: IP range of the VIP pool (optional filter)

options.name: url
options.description: The VIP Pool's endpoint URL for API operations (optional filter)

options.name: vast_asn
options.description: The cluster's ASN. Applicable only if enable_l3 is true. (optional filter)

options.name: vip_allocation
options.description: VIP allocation type (optional filter)

options.name: vlan
options.description:
VIPPool VLAN, if the VIP pool is tagged with a specific VLAN. The VIP pool is exposed only to the specified VLAN
on the client data network (optional filter)

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.

options.name: vms_preferred
options.description: If true, CNodes participating in the vip pool are preferred in VMS host election. (optional filter)
